provenance.title: Thresholds under doors
provenance.covers: What goes under a door where the floor surface changes. Written from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Approved Document M: Access to and use of buildings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. A strip under the door where two floor surfaces meet. Keep it low so it is easy to cross.
Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. A door whose edge is this close to the end of its room is taken to join it to the next room.
Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. Where a wet-safe surface meets a dry one, a bar keeps water from creeping under the dry floor.
